why.en: Asks your configured resolver for example.com, just like the laptop in the lesson.
why.hinglish: Aapke configured resolver se example.com maangta hai, bilkul lesson ke laptop ki tarah.

expect.en: The resolver address and one or more A records for example.com. dig also shows flags (qr rd ra), the TTL and the query time. Addresses and times vary by machine.
expect.hinglish: Resolver ka address aur example.com ke ek ya zyada A records. dig flags (qr rd ra), TTL aur query time bhi dikhata hai. Addresses aur times machine ke hisaab se alag hote hain.

title.en: Walk the tree from the root

why.en: dig +trace repeats the resolver's walk: root, then .com, then example.com's own servers.
why.hinglish: dig +trace resolver ka walk repeat karta hai: root, phir .com, phir example.com ke apne servers.

expect.en: Several blocks: the root servers' NS list, the .com servers, example.com's name servers, then the final A record. Server names and addresses can differ.
expect.hinglish: Kai blocks: root servers ki NS list, .com servers, example.com ke name servers, phir final A record. Server names aur addresses alag ho sakte hain.

why.en: Query a public resolver twice a few seconds apart. The second answer comes from its cache with a smaller TTL.
why.hinglish: Public resolver se do baar kuch seconds ke gap pe poocho. Doosra answer uske cache se kam TTL ke saath aata hai.

expect.en: The A record with a TTL number. Run it again after a few seconds and the TTL is lower. Values vary.
expect.hinglish: A record ek TTL number ke saath. Kuch seconds baad dobara chalao to TTL kam hoga. Values alag ho sakti hain.

why.en: A name that does not exist gets the definite answer NXDOMAIN (rcode 3).
why.hinglish: Jo name exist nahi karta use pakka jawab NXDOMAIN (rcode 3) milta hai.

expect.en: nslookup says 'Non-existent domain'; dig shows 'status: NXDOMAIN' and an SOA record in the authority section.
expect.hinglish: nslookup 'Non-existent domain' kehta hai; dig 'status: NXDOMAIN' aur authority section mein SOA record dikhata hai.
